northStar: Turn repeated mechanical corrections into deterministic AST gates with red/green proof.
falsifiable: A generated gate is retained only when its own red fixture exits 1 and green fixture exits 0.

proven.claim: The L9 self-verification path rejects a generated gate that exits 0 on its red fixture and leaves no gate artifact behind.
The configured pi model path generated a new loose-equality AST gate whose own red fixture exited 1 and green fixture exited 0.
The check command forwards AST-gate file:line evidence, exits 1 for a violation, and exits 0 for a clean fixture.

unproven.claim: Generated gates reduce recurring review effort across a production codebase.
